title: 2026 election live updates as Supreme Court denies Trump bid to separate California ballots, candidates make final pitches - CBS News
description: President Trump held an event Monday at the Washington, D.C., Reflecting Pool, while Michigan Democrats assess the fallout from a cross-party endorsement.

title: Child in New York dies after contracting measles, governor says - CNN
description: A child in Lewis County, New York, has died after contracting measles, Gov. Kathy Hochul said in a statement Monday. It is the state’s first measles-related death in 30 years.

title: Thousands of blood pressure medication bottles recalled nationwide after pills fail quality test - Fox Business
description: The nationwide recall affects thousands of bottles of prescription blood pressure tablets from two lots, both with an expiration date of May 31, 2027.

title: Frantic Binance Hackers Created Windfall for Fast Crypto Traders - Bloomberg.com
description: For most crypto investors, the theft of $6.3 billion from Binance was a reminder of the risks that still surround digital assets. For a small group of fast-moving trading firms and skilled investors, it was a chance to make a quick buck.
